description: This file defines the LinkRenderer class, a custom renderer for links in markdown content, handling different URL types (absolute, external, internal, anchors) in the context of the Daux documentation generator.

classes.name: LinkRenderer
classes.description: A custom renderer class for markdown links within the Daux documentation system, handling different link types for rendering.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Processes a link node to generate its HTML representation, handling external links, internal anchors, and internal files, with appropriate CSS classes.
